story.text: 승객 여러분, 이번엔 냄새만으로도 행복해지는 상공입니다. 한국의 길거리 음식 이야기, 배고프지 않게 잘 들어주세요!
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-beon-en naem-sae-man-eu-ro-do haeng-bok-hae-ji-neun sang-gong-im-ni-da.
story.en: Passengers, this time we're flying over a place that makes you happy just from the smell. Please listen carefully — you might get hungry!

story.text: 가장 먼저, '떡볶이'! 맵고 달콤한 떡과 국물이 중독적이에요.
story.reading: ga-jang meon-jeo, tteok-bok-i! maep-go dal-kom-han tteok-gwa gung-mul-i jung-dok-jeog-i-e-yo.
story.en: First up, 'tteokbokki'! The spicy-sweet rice cakes and sauce are addictive.

story.text: 옆에는 항상 '튀김'이 함께해요. 떡볶이 국물에 찍어 먹으면 더 맛있답니다.
story.en: 'Fried snacks' always come alongside. Dipping them in tteokbokki sauce makes them even tastier.

story.text: 겨울이라면 따끈한 '붕어빵'을 꼭 드셔보세요. 팥 앙금이 가득 들어있어요.
story.en: If it's winter, be sure to try warm 'bungeoppang'. It's filled with sweet red bean paste.

story.text: 쫄깃한 식감을 원하신다면 '순대'도 좋아요. 소금이나 초장에 찍어 먹어요.
story.en: If you want a chewy texture, 'sundae' is great too. Dip it in salt or vinegared gochujang.

story.text: 이 모든 음식은 '포장마차'에서 만날 수 있어요. 저녁이면 곳곳에 불이 켜지죠.
story.reading: i mo-deun eum-sig-eun po-jang-ma-cha-e-seo man-nal su i-sseo-yo.
story.en: You can find all of this food at 'street food tents'. In the evening, lights turn on everywhere.

story.text: 벌써 배가 고파지지 않나요? 오늘 배운 소울푸드 단어들로 문제를 풀어봅시다!
story.en: Are you already getting hungry? Let's solve some questions with today's soul food words!

words.example_en: You dip fried snacks in tteokbokki sauce.
Bungeoppang is really delicious in winter.
Shall we eat some sundae together too?
I eat dinner at a street food tent.

sentences.en: Tteokbokki is the soul food of Koreans.
There are so many kinds of fried snacks.
Bungeoppang is a representative winter snack.
Try dipping sundae in salt before eating.
Every street food tent has its own charm.
